mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_packages (id, title, description, cover_url, category, original_price, selling_price, expire_days, course_count, is_active, is_featured, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}, #{title}, #{description}, #{coverUrl}, #{category}, #{originalPrice}, #{sellingPrice}, #{expireDays}, #{courseCount}, #{isActive}, #{isFeatured}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE course_packages SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, category = #{category}, original_price = #{originalPrice}, selling_price = #{sellingPrice}, expire_days = #{expireDays}, is_active = #{isActive}, is_featured = #{isFeatured}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
UPDATE course_packages SET course_count = #{count}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id, typeHandler=com.flittly.bankendspringboot.config.UUIDTypeHandler}
